description: This file defines a React component for adding a new guardrail configuration in a UI context. It handles form rendering, data fetching, provider-specific configurations, and submission logic for creating guardrails with support for various modes and settings.

methods.name: handleProviderChange
methods.description: Handles selection change of the guardrail provider, resets provider-specific and PII states.

methods.name: handleEntitySelect
methods.description: Toggles selection of a PII entity.

methods.name: handleActionSelect
methods.description: Sets the action for a specific PII entity.

methods.name: handleCategorySelect
methods.description: Toggles selection of a content moderation category in Azure Text Moderation settings.

methods.name: handleGlobalSeverityChange
methods.description: Adjusts the severity threshold for all categories.

methods.name: handleCategorySeverityChange
methods.description: Adjusts severity for a specific content category.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Validates current step fields and proceeds to the next configuration step.

methods.name: prevStep
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous configuration step.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets all form fields and internal component states to initial.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the modal and resets form state.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Validates all inputs, constructs the guardrail payload, and calls API to create the guardrail.
